selection.rule: Homepage events come from current RSS/advisory sources. CVEs are shown only when the source article/advisory mentions them.

items.title: Fortinet warns of critical FortiMail flaw exploited in zero-day attacks
items.summary: Fortinet is warning customers of a critical FortiMail vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-104286, that is being actively exploited in zero-day attacks to execute unauthorized code or commands on vulnerable devices. [...]
items.title_zh: Fortinet 警告已遭零日攻擊利用的 FortiMail 重大漏洞
items.summary_zh: Fortinet 正警告客戶注意一個追蹤為 CVE-2026-104286 的 FortiMail 重大漏洞，該漏洞正於零日攻擊中遭積極利用，用以在受影響的裝置上執行未授權的程式碼或指令。[...]

items.title: Police dismantle KillSec ransomware gang allegedly led by 16-year-old
items.summary: An international law enforcement operation dubbed "Operation KillSwitch" seized the KillSec ransomware gang's data leak site and servers, led to three arrests, and identified a 16-year-old as the group's alleged administrator. [...]
items.title_zh: 警方瓦解涉嫌由 16 歲少年領導的 KillSec 勒索軟體集團
items.summary_zh: 一項代號為「Operation KillSwitch」的國際執法行動，扣押了 KillSec 勒索軟體集團的資料外洩網站與伺服器，逮捕了三人，並確認一名 16 歲少年為該集團的涉案管理者。[...]

items.title: Police Shut Down KillSec Ransomware, Identify Alleged Teen Leader
items.summary: Police took control of KillSec’s leak site and secured at least 110 terabytes of data stolen from victims. The post Police Shut Down KillSec Ransomware, Identify Alleged Teen Leader appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 警方關閉 KillSec 勒索軟體並確認涉案青少年首腦
items.summary_zh: 警方掌握了 KillSec 外洩網站的控制權，並查獲至少 110 TB 從受害者處竊取的資料。這篇《Police Shut Down KillSec Ransomware, Identify Alleged Teen Leader》文章首次出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Zimbra Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild Prior to Public Disclosure
items.summary: Under certain conditions, CVE-2026-73570 can be exploited via specially crafted emails without user interaction. The post Zimbra Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild Prior to Public Disclosure appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Zimbra 漏洞在公開披露前已遭野外利用
items.summary_zh: 在特定條件下，CVE-2026-73570 可透過特製的電子郵件在無需使用者互動的情況下被利用。Zimbra Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild Prior to Public Disclosure 文章最早出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Zammad Zero-Days Exploited in AI-Powered DIVD Hack
items.summary: The flaws were chained to hijack sessions, achieve remote code execution, and elevate privileges to root. The post Zammad Zero-Days Exploited in AI-Powered DIVD Hack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Zammad 零日漏洞於 AI 驅動的 DIVD 黑客活動中遭利用
items.summary_zh: 這些漏洞被串聯用於劫持會話、實現遠端執行程式碼，並將權限提升至 root。Zammad Zero-Days Exploited in AI-Powered DIVD Hack 文章最早出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: DIVD says Zammad zero-days enabled AI-driven network breach
items.summary: The Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure (DIVD) says that the breach of its network was possible by exploiting a chain of two zero-day vulnerabilities in the open-source Zammad ticketing system. [...]
items.title_zh: DIVD 表示 Zammad 零日漏洞導致 AI 驅動的網路入侵
items.summary_zh: 荷蘭漏洞披露研究所（DIVD）表示，攻擊者透過利用開源 Zammad 工單系統中的兩個零日漏洞鏈，入侵了其網路。[...]

items.title: Cisco warns of new SD-WAN zero-day exploited in attacks
items.summary: Cisco released security updates to address a critical zero-day in the Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (tracked as CVE-2026-76504) that attackers are actively exploiting to escalate to admin privileges. [...]
